verdicts.reason: A shrinks the square into a narrow central column: the logo is centred at the top but the quote mark and headline are left-aligned at a different axis, so the two don't line up. The headline is small for the banner, 'Rated 5 out of 5' is too tiny to read, and large dead areas sit on both sides. B uses the banner well, with a large headline and quote mark reading left to right, but the right side is scattered: the 'Sound & Stereo Review' credit floats at the top, far from 'Rated 5 out of 5' at the bottom, with a void between them. The Obsidian logo sits on a third, arbitrary axis, and the credit text is very small.
